vi: Phân biệt ALB (L7 HTTP/HTTPS/gRPC path-based) vs NLB (L4 TCP/UDP preserve source IP ultra-high throughput) vs GLB (GenAI packet inspection) cho đúng use case
Cấu hình ALB listener + listener rule: default target group + if-condition (host/path/header/method) then forward/redirect/fixed-response weighted canary distribution
Thiết kế target group health check (shallow vs deep): protocol/path/interval/healthy-threshold, cascade failure khi sai path, stickiness (cookie-based/duration-based)
Gắn NLB Elastic IP tĩnh qua subnet_mapping cho đặc thù preserve client source IP, kỳ vọng security group complexity tại instance layer
Troubleshoot LB fail-away: CloudWatch UnHealthyHostCount, check target group health status per AZ, session affinity mất sau LB failover, fix target group deregistration delay
en: Distinguish ALB (L7 HTTP/HTTPS/gRPC path-based) vs NLB (L4 TCP/UDP preserve source IP ultra-high throughput) vs GLB (GenAI packet inspection) for correct use cases
Configure ALB listener and listener rules: default target group plus if-condition (host/path/header/method) then forward/redirect/fixed-response with weighted canary distribution
Design target group health check (shallow vs deep): protocol/path/interval/healthy-threshold, cascade failure on wrong path, stickiness via cookie or duration
Attach NLB static Elastic IP via subnet_mapping for source IP preservation, expect security group complexity at instance layer
Troubleshoot LB fail-away: CloudWatch UnHealthyHostCount, check target group health per AZ, session affinity lost after LB failover, adjust deregistration delay
